text:
Zoe Lin: Reminder 00: Nimbus Systems webinar next Thurs 11:00 PT. Joint session: on-prem Private deployment + SI integration demo. Need speaker confirmations, HSM/KMS notes, quantized model check, swag raffle logistics, and marketplace listing timing.

Harish Patel: I'll own the demo plumbing. Route: on-prem appliance (Nimbus lab) -> Redwood Private fallback -> Redwood Hosted as last-resort. Plan to exercise HSM-bound key for request signing. Will run key rotation smoke tests.

Dana Morales: Speaker plan: Zoe intro (5m), Harish infra demo (12m), Viktor SI integration walk-through (10m), live Q&A (8m). Please upload bios + profile pics by Tue EOD.

Viktor Sousa: On SI notes: we'll show SAML provisioning, SCIM user sync, and a small script to wire Nimbus console to Redwood's private endpoint. Demo snippet: `python sync_users.py --env=staging --dry-run`. Need credentials set in secret manager.

Harish Patel: Model note: running a 4-bit quantized Llama-2 variant (q4_k_m). Validate that attention cache behaves properly under 512-token sequences. Test script for perf:

```
# perf sweep
for s in 128 256 512; do ./bench --seq $s --model q4_k_m; done
```

Dana Morales: Swag: stickers (150), hoodies (30), enamel card holders (45). We'll raffle 5 lab access vouchers. Need form to capture attendees. UX wants a QR code printed on table. Design: `NIMBUS_RDW_QR.png` in Drive.

Ship-bot: Logistics update: courier NimbusFreight AWB NF234567. Expected venue delivery Wed 17:00. Customs cleared; attached invoice via portal.

Zoe Lin: HSM/KMS: note that Nimbus requires customer-managed KMS for private demo. Harish, can you confirm we can sign requests with the HSM-backed key and that no private keys leave the appliance?

Harish Patel: Confirmed: signing happens inside the HSM; we send PSK-signed JWT to Redwood Private. Test command: `openssl pkeyutl -sign -inkey hsm:slot2 -in payload.bin -out sig.bin`. Also we'll demo key rotation with zero-downtime using a secondary sign key.

Viktor Sousa: SI creds: please add `si-demo@nimbus.example` to SCIM test group. I'll coordinate with Nimbus ops for provisioning by Tue noon.

Dana Morales: Marketing asks for marketplace timing: Nimbus wants the listing live at 13:00 PT same day. We need final marketplace blurb + screenshots by Wed 18:00 for approval. Legal signoff required.

Harish Patel: Failover policy: if median latency > 350ms for 60s OR any auth failure >= 1%, shift traffic to Redwood Private. Implement circuit-breaker with 30s cooldown. I will push runbook to shared folder.

Zoe Lin: AV/onsite: bring 2x HDMI adaptors, 1x USB-C ethernet adapter, power strips, and a small router for isolated demo network. Onsite lead: Priyanka (Nimbus) +1-555-4321.

Viktor Sousa: For the raffle, use a short Google Form and generate QR shortlink. I'll create and post link in thread when ready.

Ship-bot: Customs docs note: include ECCN 5D002 and commercial invoice. Unable to clear without vendor EIN attached; vendor provided EIN today.

Dana Morales: Rehearsal: Wed 16:00 PT. Please be available. Also prepping a 90s backup video uploaded to S3 labeled `nimbus_fallback.mp4` in case live demo is flaky.

Harish Patel: I'll run full failover smoke test Tue night and post logs. Quick test snippet for signing + request:

```
payload='{"input":"healthcheck"}'
openssl pkeyutl -sign -inkey hsm:slot2 -in <(echo -n "$payload") -out sig.bin
curl -s -X POST https://private.redwood.local/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $(cat sig.bin | base64)" \
  -d "$payload"
```

Zoe Lin: Action items recap: @Harish run HSM key tests + failover smoke by Tue EOD; @Viktor prep SI provisioning + raffle form by Tue noon; @Dana finalize market blurb + upload fallback video by Wed noon; @Ship-bot confirm delivery Wed 17:00. React with :white_check_mark: when done.

Harish Patel: :white_check_mark: will do tests Tue.

Viktor Sousa: :white_check_mark: provisioning scheduled.

Dana Morales: :white_check_mark: working on blurb and video.

Ship-bot: Delivery confirmed NF234567 scheduled Wed 17:05 local.
